answer.answer: APY stands for Atal Pension Yojana [E01]. It guarantees a minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60, with options of Rs. 1,000/-, Rs. 2,000/-, Rs. 3,000/-, Rs. 4,000/-, or Rs. 5,000/- per month [E02].
